dimensions.zero: Optimizes the accepted-case percentage or provider count while disregarding eligible refusals.
dimensions.one: Uses total eligible confirmations but leaves the denominator or refusal consequence unclear.
dimensions.two: Chooses by customer-confirmed outcomes among all nine registered arrivals, counting refusals in the buyer's responsibility.

dimensions.zero: Assumes the provider accepts loss-making or tie-rejected complex work under A or B, or chooses an impossible subset.
dimensions.one: Identifies cherry-picking but incompletely handles the capacity/profit response under C.
dimensions.two: Correctly anticipates six routine under A/B and six routine plus one complex under C, or supplies an equivalent valid best-response comparison.

dimensions.zero: Uses unavailable fallback, misses the $19 ceiling, or treats a refusal as already confirmed.
dimensions.one: Feasible selected action but incomplete fallback or spending account.
dimensions.two: Uses at most one refused complex case through fallback, with C totaling eight confirmations and $19, and respects the cap for the alternatives considered.

dimensions.zero: Selects A or B as superior despite the fixed objective and feasible C.
dimensions.one: Selects C but gives a materially incomplete reason for why the other offers cannot match it.
dimensions.two: Recommends C on confirmed totals under the actual response; concise comparison suffices.

dimensions.zero: Treats the accepted-only dashboard as evidence that refused cases were resolved or that a higher acceptance percentage means higher total outcomes.
dimensions.one: Notes the dashboard omission but leaves its consequence for this choice unclear.
dimensions.two: Uses the independent registry to keep refused eligible cases visible and explains why the dashboard's denominator cannot establish the buyer's total outcome.

critical_failures: Recommends an action that breaches the hard payment ceiling or uses unavailable fallback capacity.
Counts refused or unconfirmed cases as customer-confirmed resolutions.
Substitutes accepted-case completion percentage for the fixed all-eligible confirmed-total objective.
Claims to have observed new outcomes or executed a test outside the dossier.
D2C.accepted_answer_policy: A concise feasible recommendation earns full credit without exhaustive subset enumeration, special terminology, new audits or invented policies. Do not double-charge one error across dimensions unless it separately changes another required conclusion.

dimensions.zero: Uses the repairer's displayed selected-order rate as the network objective.
dimensions.one: Recognizes eligible-order totals but does not account for refusals in the decision.
dimensions.two: Optimizes Friday customer confirmations across all nine registered orders, including the consequences of refusals.

dimensions.zero: Assumes zero-profit long orders are selected under X or assigns more than eight repairer hours.
dimensions.one: Recognizes selection but incompletely resolves the profitable mix under Z.
dimensions.two: Correctly derives four short under X and four short plus two long under Y/Z, or an equivalent valid response argument.

dimensions.zero: Uses more than two backup long orders, assigns backup short orders, or exceeds $20.
dimensions.one: Feasible action but incomplete backup or payment account.
dimensions.two: Uses two backup long orders under Z, obtaining eight confirmations for $20; handles the cap when comparing other schedules.

dimensions.zero: Recommends X or Y as yielding more feasible confirmations than Z.
dimensions.one: Recommends Z but fails to establish why it beats X and Y under the cap.
dimensions.two: Chooses Z for its feasible confirmed total; brief alternative comparison suffices.

dimensions.zero: Infers all eligible orders were fixed from the selected-order completion rate.
dimensions.one: Mentions unseen refusals without linking them to the policy's outcome.
dimensions.two: Uses the independent register to expose refused long orders and explains that the displayed rate hides those missing outcomes.

critical_failures: Recommends an action that breaches the $20 cap or backup capacity/type restriction.
Counts a refusal or an unconfirmed order as a confirmed fix.
Replaces the all-eligible confirmed-total objective with the selected-order rate.
Claims new observation or a performed test not in the dossier.
D2H.accepted_answer_policy: A short correct answer may earn ten. Do not demand all subset calculations, an invented payment scheme, a new evidence-gathering step, or framework language. Charge a root mistake once unless independently consequential.

dimensions.zero: Optimizes the provider's six accepted cases alone.
dimensions.one: Recognizes nine eligible cases but leaves the goal implicit.
dimensions.two: Uses all nine eligible customer confirmations as the objective.

dimensions.zero: Contradicts the supplied fixed provider response or proposes a contract change.
dimensions.one: Uses the six provider confirmations but does not state the refused complex cases remain.
dimensions.two: Accepts the stipulated six confirmed routine cases and three registered complex refusals.

dimensions.zero: Assigns fallback beyond its capacity or to a wrong class.
dimensions.one: Uses backup but fewer than three complex cases without a valid reason.
dimensions.two: Sends all three refused complex cases to the available fallback desk.

dimensions.zero: Gives a total or payment that changes the decision incorrectly.
dimensions.one: Correct action with incomplete count or spending.
dimensions.two: Reports nine confirmations and $21 total payment: $12 provider plus $9 fallback.

dimensions.zero: Withholds the feasible decision pending invented evidence or unauthorised process.
dimensions.one: Right action but frames it as contingent on facts already supplied.
dimensions.two: Directly recommends the existing contract plus full fallback, with no needless change or delay.

critical_failures: Breaches the $21 payment ceiling or the fallback limit.
Treats a refused case as confirmed without fallback resolution.
Claims an unsupplied observation or test was performed.
D2K.accepted_answer_policy: A one-sentence direct calculation can earn ten; no comparison menu or extra safeguards are required.
